people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.
translations.bsb: “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?” they said. “Does He not also speak through us?” And the LORD heard this.
translations.kjv: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard
translations.asv: And they said, Hath Jehovah indeed spoken only with Moses? hath he not spoken also with us? And Jehovah heard it.
